rows.title: AUTO BODY AND PAINT TECHNICIAN
objectives: Apply general safety practices in addition to the specific procedures related to the Auto Collision Repair industry.
Analyze and evaluate waste products from the repair task and dispose of the residue or trash according to Federal, State and Local rules and regulations.
Understand the use and safety requirements of all solvents used in automotive applications.

Use the information from service manuals, charts, tables, graphs or databases to determine manufacturer’s specifications for systems operations and the appropriate repair/replacement part and procedures.
Select and properly use the correct hand and power tools to repair auto body/collision damage.
Convert measurements as necessary to U.S. Standard or Metric specifications.
Explain the principle of force as it applies to the realignment of body and frame components.
Demonstrate the concept of pressure in relation to force when realigning body and frame components.
Use precision measuring tools to determine if repairs and replaced components are within manufacturers specifications.
Explain the necessity of knowing that the hardness of a metal determines its function and location in the automobile.
Explain how fillers and finishes adhere to metals.
Demonstrate current welding techniques used to repair modern auto body designs.

Demonstrate and use Microsoft Project or a similar tool on a computer system to create and manage a project.

Explain the key concepts and tools necessary to start a business, produce products and manage home-based, E-commerce driven, mobile, brick-and-mortar or commercial textile product enterprises.
Identify the types of business models and provide examples of their application in sewn products enterprises.
Write a clearly defined statement describing a product’s target customer.
Create a source guide for materials, resources, and production needs.
Explain and develop a networking strategy, which identifies and incorporates mentors, industry peers, advisory groups, and target customers.
Explain current trends, regulations and advancements in sustainable sewn product manufacturing and retail operations.

Demonstrate effective communication skills, ethics and professional conduct in group or team settings.
Describe graphic communications careers including specific job responsibilities.
Explain the basic design principles and best practices employed in the visual design industry.
Demonstrate how pixel based and vector-based graphics are created and used in digital layout design.

rows.title: Introduction to Networks (ITN)
objectives: Implement initial settings including passwords, IP addressing, and default gateway parameters on a network switch and end devices.
Explain how network protocols enable devices to access local and remote network resources.
Explain how physical layer protocols, services, and network media support communications across data networks.
Calculate numbers between decimal, binary, and hexadecimal systems.
Explain how media access control in the data link layer supports communication across networks.
Explain how Ethernet operates in a switched network.
Explain how routers use network layer protocols and services to enable end-to-end connectivity.
Explain how Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) and Neighbor Discovery (ND) enable communication on a network.
Implement initial settings on a router and end devices.
Calculate an IP version 4 (IPv4) subnetting scheme to efficiently segment a network.
Implement an IPv6 addressing scheme.
Use various tools to test.
Configure switches and routers with device hardening features to enhance security.
Implement a network design for a small network to include a router, a switch, and end devices.
